name: Uesugi Kenshin
source:
The holy warrior who carries out justice.
An undefeated god of war who is called the dragon or tiger of Echigo.
He has a heavy sense of duty and has no mercy for those without honor.
He's the opposite of [url=/c44434]Shingen[/url] in that he doesn't sweat the small stuff.
translation:
The holy warrior who carries out justice.
An undefeated god of war who is called the dragon or tiger of Echigo.
He has a heavy sense of duty and has no mercy for those without honor.
He's the opposite of [url=/c44434]Shingen[/url] in that he doesn't sweat the small stuff.
